description: This file is a PHP script for executing various diagnostic operations in a SuiteCRM environment, such as gathering system info, database schema, logs, configuration files, MD5 checks, bean class files, and creating a ZIP archive of diagnostic data.

methods.name: sodUpdateProgressBar
methods.description: Updates a progress bar indicator based on item weight.

methods.name: array_as_table
methods.description: Formats an array of data as an HTML table with a header.

methods.name: getFullTableDump
methods.description: Generates a full HTML dump of a database table's schema and data.

methods.name: deleteDir
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and its contents.

methods.name: prepareDiag
methods.description: Initializes the diagnostic process, creating necessary directories and UI display.

methods.name: executesugarlog
methods.description: Copies the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM log file into the diagnostic directory.

methods.name: executephpinfo
methods.description: Captures PHP configuration info via phpinfo() and saves it into an HTML file.

methods.name: executeconfigphp
methods.description: Writes the current config array to a PHP file, masking sensitive info.

methods.name: execute_sql
methods.description: Performs database info, schema, and dump extraction based on parameters.

methods.name: executebeanlistbeanfiles
methods.description: Checks for existence of bean class files listed in beanLists.

methods.name: executecustom_dir
methods.description: Zips the custom directory for diagnostics.

methods.name: executemd5
methods.description: Performs MD5 file comparisons and stores results.

methods.name: executevardefs
methods.description: Generates and saves a schema listing from vardefs files.

methods.name: finishDiag
methods.description: Compresses diagnostics into ZIP, provides download links, and cleans up temp directories.
